name: Sentry
description: Developer/infra platform: error tracking and application performance monitoring with a REST API over issues, events, projects, releases and alerts.
access_notes: Free developer plan; organization tokens, internal-integration tokens and personal tokens are all created self-serve from Sentry settings. Legacy API keys are disabled for new accounts.
mcp_notes: Official remote Sentry MCP at https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp (repo getsentry/sentry-mcp) using OAuth, with optional Sentry-Bearer token header and a local @sentry/mcp-server package. Composio SENTRY toolkit exists (211 tools, OAUTH2, Composio managed auth).
uncertainty_notes: Sentry's free-plan existence is well known but was not re-verified on the pricing page this pass; token creation being self-serve is verified in docs. OAuth2 (authorization code + PKCE) is documented for third-party apps; most automation uses org/internal-integration bearer tokens.

evidence.note: Auth tokens passed as Authorization: Bearer; OAuth2 authorization-code grant documented for third-party applications (sentry.io/oauth/authorize + /oauth/token, PKCE recommended); API keys described as legacy and disabled for new accounts.
Organization tokens, internal integration tokens, and personal tokens are all created self-serve in Sentry settings for programmatic API use.
Integration platform webhooks: Sentry sends signed HTTP POST callbacks for issues, alerts, errors, comments and installation events.
Official Sentry MCP Server at https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp; 'All connections use OAuth'; vendor repo getsentry/sentry-mcp.
Composio toolkit catalog lists Sentry (slug SENTRY, 211 tools, OAUTH2, Composio managed app: Yes).
